authorization.instruction: record the two owner-machine findings (silent first-launch sandbox failure on Xubuntu 26.04; bundled Linux candidate ships no launcher icon) as a corrective maintenance package, fix them, update delivery.json, and open a PR.

acceptance.evidence: Reproduced on the owner machine: rc.1 installer/self-test pass but Electron aborts pre-window (FATAL setuid_sandbox_host, exit 133) with apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1 and non-setuid bundled chrome-sandbox. Remedy verified live: scoped AppArmor userns profile loads, launcher opens on :0, renderer shows NoNewPrivs/Seccomp=2, zero-byte log. docs/native_distribution.md documents both sanctioned remedies; installer prints a non-fatal NOTE at install time (packaging/sandbox-notice.sh, sysctl-parameterized).

Project-owned icon in packaging/icons generated by scripts/make_icon.py; Linux candidates bundle it (scripts/distribution.py), install-linux.sh writes Icon=poliscope and installs the 256px PNG into the user hicolor directory; harness test asserts entry content, copied icon and unchanged behavior on upgrade failure paths.

freeze_release.py supports --label 0.1.0-rc.N and an active receipt in the label's release directory; verify() rejects malformed labels and keeps rc.1 receipts immutable. New docs/releases/0.1.0-rc.2/ receipt freezes 665 inputs at implementation commit f773c6a; scripts/freeze_release.py --check passes; tests/roadmap retained check passes against the active receipt.
